```plato

    //==
    // # Narrow phase over a whole world
    //
    // Turning a set of manifolds into the constraint rows one step solves, and one
    // worked scene — balls and a ground plane — driven end to end.
    //
    // There is NO BROAD PHASE here. The scene driver below tests every ordered pair
    // of bodies, so its cost is the square of the body count. A broad phase (a
    // sweep-and-prune over bounds, or a BVH) reduces that to the pairs whose bounds
    // actually overlap; `stdlib/geometry` already declares the spatial-index
    // vocabulary such a phase would be written against, and putting one here would
    // be a second piece of work rather than a detail of this one.

    // The rows of one manifold, with each point's approach speed measured against
    // the bodies as they currently stand — which is the moment the measurement is
    // meaningful, because the velocity solve is about to change it.
    ConstraintRows(m: ContactManifold3D, bodies: Array<SolverBody3D>, threshold: Speed)
        : Array<ContactConstraint3D>
        => m.Points.Map(p => ConstraintRow(m, p,
            SeparationSpeed(bodies[m.BodyA.Value], bodies[m.BodyB.Value], p.Position, p.Normal.Vector),
            threshold));
```
